destination.name: Jiangshan
destination.tagline: Danxia sandstone peaks, ancient clan villages and a stone-paved pass on the Zhejiang border
destination.description: Jiangshan is a county-level city in south-west Zhejiang and the base for Mount Jianglang, three red sandstone peaks in a line that are part of China Danxia World Heritage. Nearby Qingyang Village is the ancestral village of the Jiangnan Mao clan, with a clan ancestral hall. The Xianxia ancient road climbs through four gates on about five km of stone-paved path.

goodToKnow.title: Expect steep stairs
goodToKnow.detail: Reaching the summit viewpoints on Mount Jianglang means a long climb on steps. Start early and bring water.

goodToKnow.title: Sights are spread out
goodToKnow.detail: The peaks, village and pass lie some distance apart. Taxis or a hired driver from Jiangshan town work best.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: Jiangshan is best in {months}, when clear, cooler days make the long climbs comfortable.
